neighbours.label: ' single' (and ' one') meaning exactly one, as in 'a single dose', 'single-blind', 'single-centre'
fire: Patients received a single injection of the vaccine in the upper arm.
The trial was single-blind, so only the assessors knew the groups.
The plant flowers only once and produces a single seed pod.
The whole report was written by a single author over two years.
Voters rank candidates using the single transferable vote system.
The beetle completes just a single generation each summer.
It was a retrospective, single-centre study of heart patients.
The data came from a single sensor mounted on the roof.
quiet: Patients received a booster injection of the vaccine in the upper arm.
The trial was double-blind, so neither side knew the groups.
The plant flowers every spring and produces many seed pods.
The whole report was written by a large team over two years.
Voters rank candidates using a preferential ballot system.
The beetle completes several generations each summer.
It was a retrospective, multicentre study of heart patients.
The data came from three sensors mounted on the roof.

notes: Card: ' single' x10, ' one' x7, ' first' x4 of the top 32; the + pole is 'multiple passes', so the distinction is one versus many.
